shared_elements: large frontal/standing anthropomorphic figure occupying whole surface
human head with headgear or headdress
wings or wing-like flanking forms at the shoulders
circular disc/rosette motif on the body
justification: Both depict a single dominant humanoid figure with a headdress, wing-like elements spreading from the shoulders and round disc/rosette motifs set against the body, which is a moderately specific shared combination. But A is a low-relief figure in strict profile with a raised arm, detailed feathered wing rendered as ordered rows of feathers, a stylised curled beard and fine incised garment patterning, while B is a fully three-dimensional frontal figure with a broad blank face, no arms or gesture, and only sparse schematic circular bosses and ridged bands; the conventions of rendering and the relationships between parts are quite different.
